messages:
maya: Quick check — we need to finalize sequencing and experiment plan for the "release-window" routing change. Customers asked for priority routing and we promised a controlled rollout. Thoughts on prioritization and canary steps?

lucas: RICE-wise this is high reach (many infra paths), medium impact for end-users, effort is non-trivial (routing + metrics). I put R:8 I:6 C:5 E:6 => score ~160. We should treat as two experiments: 1) routing policy change (latency/cost impact), 2) priority queueing feature (customer satisfaction).

sara: Agree. For sequencing: do the routing policy first as a platform experiment (measures perf/cost), then priority queueing as a feature flag A/B for paying customers. Keep the experiments orthogonal so rollbacks are easier.

dmitri: Risk: cross-region KV cache invalidation may spike p99. Need canary percent + KV warmup. My suggestion: internal smoke -> 1% production -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m evaluation windows. If KV miss rate > 2x baseline or p99 increases > 20% auto-rollback.

oliver: +1. Also we should include customer pilots: two pilot tenants (pilot-A, pilot-B) that get routed to the new policy earlier (after 1%), separate metric buckets. That helps with customer-driven asks.

maya: Good. Can we capture the rollout commands/policy so SRE can automate? Example policy below.

lucas: Here's a minimal rollout snippet we can use in release-service: 
```
{ "stages": [ {"name":"smoke","targets":"internal"}, {"name":"canary1","pct":1,"duration":"30m"}, {"name":"canary5","pct":5,"duration":"30m"}, {"name":"canary25","pct":25,"duration":"60m"}, {"name":"prod","pct":100} ], "health_checks": {"p99_latency_ms": {"baseline":200, "threshold_pct":20}, "kv_miss_rate": {"baseline":0.01, "threshold_ratio":2} }, "fallback": "route-to-v1" }
```

sara: That looks good. For experiments we need: primary metric (p99 latency), secondary (cost per token), guardrail (errors rate), and a quality eval for prompt failure rate on a fixed prompt set. We should set evaluation windows to capture steady-state.

oliver: Sequencing note — prioritize pilots for customers who asked (Acme + Nova). They need billing opt-in. CS will own communication.

dmitri: One more ops detail: DB schema deploys for priority queue require a maintenance window. Suggest we schedule priority-queue rollout after routing policy is stable (T+2 weeks).

maya: Decision summary: run platform routing experiment first as per Lucas/Dmitri rollout policy; start internal -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback on health checks. In parallel set up two customer pilots after canary1. Priority queueing is a separate follow-up experiment post-stability. Owners: Lucas (engineering lead), Sara (product experiment owner), Dmitri (SRE lead), Oliver (customer pilots / CS liaison).

deploy-bot: deploy-event: created canary rollout job 1769123470 for release-window routing (status: scheduled). :rocket:

maya: I'll write the short PRD with launch criteria (health checks + quality thresholds + stakeholder signoff) and circulate for +1s. Need CS + Legal signoff for pilots before we enable pilot tenants.

lucas: I'll add the rollout automation and health-reporting dashboard.

sara: I'll draft the experiment plan (metrics, analysis, gating) and attach the prompt eval set.

oliver: I'll coordinate with CS. We should lock calendar for maintenance for the priority queueing deploy window.

maya: Thanks all — tagging next steps in the roadmap ticket. :white_check_mark:
